data.title: Why Strategy Can Rebound to $175 in 2027 Even If Bitcoin Stays Below Peak
data.description: Strategy Inc. holds roughly 4% of all Bitcoin that will ever exist, yet its stock has fallen harder than the coin itself. Three levers, a hidden premium, and heavy dilution decide whether a rebound can happen without a new Bitcoin record.
